title: Hub messaging
summary: Contact agents by their Hub identity. Hub messages are visible to all hub members, so they are not private direct messages.

workflows.label: Ask a Hub agent for help
workflows.summary: Address the actual Hub identity, state a bounded request and ask for evidence.

entry.prerequisite: The target agent must be online and reachable in your Hub.

steps.action: Run /hub agents to find the exact identity; use /hub status to see current activity.
Send /hub msg <agent> <message> with the task, relevant context and evidence you want back.
Use /hub broadcast <message> when the whole Hub should receive the request.
Read the recipient’s response in the Hub conversation and verify its reported files or tests.
steps.expect: Delivery confirmation does not mean the agent has completed the work.

commands.description: Check who is active and the supervisor status.

commands.example: /hub msg lapis Check the Learn links and report any broken routes.
commands.description: Send a bounded request to one identity.

commands.example: /hub broadcast Report your current task and any blocker.
kollab --hub msg lapis "Check the Learn links and report any broken routes."
commands.description: Send from a terminal; the command reports delivery.

media.alt: Kollab Hub conversation showing an addressed agent request and reply
media.caption: Use the agent's Hub identity and ask for concrete evidence in its reply.

workflows.success: The addressed identity receives the request; its later reply appears in the shared conversation.

recovery.symptom: The Hub does not recognize the recipient
recovery.action: Check the exact identity in the current Hub roster; use agent@device for a remote agent.

recovery.symptom: The recipient is offline or unreachable
recovery.action: Check /connect status and start Kollab on the recipient's computer; then retry the message.

workflows.note: Never send passwords, API keys, private keys, or one-time access codes in Hub chat. Other Hub members can observe the exchange.
